Biggest standing risk to the book is unchanged, not newly discovered today: the levered silver loan sits ~5.6% from a stressed margin call (leverage 2.08x vs the signed 1.4x ceiling) per the book's own risk monitor (data/oneaction.json).

The rare-earth basket sold off into the Trump-Xi-Putin Shenzhen summit (MP -3.41%, Lynas -8.24%) despite MP's strong Q3 (+176% revenue, DoD-backed 100% magnet offtake) -- fundamentals strengthening even as the tape weakened.
